DEP: Import or symbol is not permitted.
DEP-CLOSED: Remove the import or review its dependency permission.
DEP-POLICY: Correct the offending key in docs/plans/dependencies.json.
DEP-ROOT: Move product mains under cmd/ and list them; declare helper harnesses.
OWNER: Package must have exactly one owner.
SOURCE: Fix the syntax at the reported location.
TRACE: Package specification reference is missing or invalid.
Add a package Spec comment naming an existing plan heading.
REQ: Implement the inspection named in the requirement register.
REQ-COVER: Use one current id on its named test in the owning component.
REQ-POLICY: Correct the offending entry in docs/plans/requirements.json.
POLICY: Correct the offending key shown in the detail.
R: Use the replacement for this rule in docs/plans/README.md#retired-terms.
NAME-POLICY: External names policy is unavailable or invalid.
Set OBERTH_GUARDS_NAMES_FILE to a file outside the repository.
NAME-SECTION: Keep one level-2 Agent plugins heading outside code fences.
HISTORY: Commit identity or message is invalid.
Amend the named commit identity or message to match repository policy.
DEADCODE: Remove the named function or exercise it through its supported entry point.
REACH: Wire the package into a listed production command or remove it.
PRODUCT: Product command is not a buildable main.
Use a real main package at the marked product path.
GO: Fix the compilation errors shown in the detail.
LEFTOVER: Finish the work or remove the marker at the reported location.
SKIP: Supply a nonempty reason for skipping this test.
TOOL: Fix the guard input and rerun the guards.
DEP-TEST: Move the import into a test file.
REQ-WALK: Walk requirement cannot be proved by a Go marker.
Remove the marker and use the planned walk step.
PIN-POLICY: Change pinned contracts in a separate commit containing only plan data.
CREDIT: Remove the authorship credit; plugin host names do not grant a credit exemption.
SCHEMA: Add each numbered migration and its previous-release database fixture.
